Waar De Bresser als vervoersbedrijf in 1: While De Bresser started out as a transport company in 1923 with nothing but a horse and cart, things look rather different in 2023. With more than three thousand removals a year in the Netherlands and abroad, transporting household contents is still our daily bread. But the expansion into storage, logistics and assembly services makes our offering more complete than ever. And we're proud of that.

Cis de Bresser richt De Bresser op en st: Cis de Bresser founds De Bresser and starts out as a transport company on the John. Lenartzstraat in Oisterwijk.
De tweede generatie, zoon Jan de Bresser: The second generation, son Jan de Bresser, continues the company as a transport and removal company.
Jan en Nico de Bresser nemen het bedrijf: Jan and Nico de Bresser take over the company from their father Jan, and so the third generation becomes active.
De Bresser neemt verhuisbedrijf Horsten: De Bresser takes over removal company Horsten en Van Disseldorp in Tilburg and opens its second branch and container warehouse on the Vossenberg in Tilburg.
In dit jaar wordt het eerste tentbed ver: This year, De Bresser transports its first folding bed, which later becomes a major part of the service offering.
Tomas Brands neemt De Bresser over van d: Tomas Brands takes over De Bresser from the third and last generation, Jan de Bresser, who retires after a well-earned career.
De Bresser opent een wasserij voor medis: De Bresser opens a laundry for medical aids in Oisterwijk.
De Bresser neemt Stoof Verhuizingen in B: De Bresser takes over Stoof Verhuizingen in Breda and opens a third branch there.
De Bresser start het nieuwe label Ontzor: De Bresser launches the new label Ontzorgd Verhuizen. This is a dedicated service covering everything to do with removals for seniors.
